About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

岗位概述

我们正处于 AI 重塑金融基础设施的历史节点。作为 AI Agent 架构师，你将成为 AI 智能体系的核心构建者——不只是编写代码，而是定义下一代金融级 Agent 如何感知市场信号、规划执行路径、记忆业务上下文与跨系统协作。你将主导打造可承载真实金融场景的 Agent 体系，覆盖交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察、用户智能服务等核心业务，让 AI 在加密金融的高速、高压、高合规环境中真正自主完成复杂任务。这里没有边界模糊的分工，有的是直接影响亿级用户体验的技术决策权，以及一支对 LLM 与 Agent 技术有极高密度认知的精英工程团队。

核心职责

  1. Agent 体系架构设计：主导设计 AI 智能体架构，定义 Agent 在 Openclaw 平台上的运行模型、生命周期管理与资源隔离策略；构建支撑交易辅助、风控研判、合规监察等金融核心场景的 Agent 能力基座，确保系统在高并发、低延迟、强合规约束下稳定运行。
  2. 金融场景 Agent 工程化落地：将交易信号分析、风险识别、监管合规、智能客服等业务需求转化为可执行的 Agent 工作流；设计任务规划链路（ReAct / Plan-and-Execute）、异常回退机制与结果验证体系，推动 Agent 从 PoC 快速进入生产环境。
  3. Openclaw 平台建设与演进：深度参与 Openclaw Agent Runtime 的架构演进与性能优化；设计插件体系、能力注册中心与多 Agent 编排机制，降低业务团队接入成本，持续提升平台的扩展性与复用率。
  4. 工具生态与内部系统集成：构建标准化工具调用框架，打通 Bybit 内部交易引擎、风控系统、数据平台与外部 API；设计工具权限管控、调用链追踪与错误恢复机制，集成 MCP 等标准协议，构建金融级异构工具生态。
  5. 生产质量与可观测性体系：主导 Agent 系统的可观测性建设，包括 Trace 追踪、Evaluation 评测、成本监控与延迟治理；建立金融场景下的 Agent 质量基线与回归测试体系，持续提升系统稳定性与可解释性。
  6. 技术前瞻与团队赋能：持续追踪 Agent 领域前沿进展，将研究成果转化为 AI 工程实践；制定团队 Agent 开发规范与最佳实践，通过 Code Review、技术分享与方向评审推动团队整体 AI-native 工程能力提升。

任职要求

  1. 扎实的 LLM/Agent 工程经验：具备 3年以上 AI 系统开发经验，其中 1年以上 大型语言模型（LLM）、RAG 或 Agent 系统的生产环境落地经验；具备 Openclaw 平台的开发与优化实战经验，熟悉其 Agent Runtime 架构、插件体系与多 Agent 编排机制，能基于 Openclaw 独立完成复杂 Agent 应用的工程化落地与性能调优。
  2. 系统架构能力：具备分布式系统设计能力，熟悉微服务架构、消息队列（Kafka / RabbitMQ）、异步任务调度等工程模式；能够独立完成从需求分析、架构设计到技术选型的完整决策链路。
  3. 编程能力：熟悉至少一门后端语言（Golang / Java / Node.js）；具备 REST API 设计与 Docker / Kubernetes 容器化部署能力。
  4. LLM 核心技术理解：深入理解 Transformer 架构、Attention 机制、Prompt Engineering（CoT、Few-shot、Structured Output）；熟悉主流模型 API（OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini）及本地部署方案（Ollama、vLLM）。
  5. 工程质量意识：具备良好的代码设计习惯（设计模式、单元测试、CI/CD）；有构建 LLM 评测（Evaluation）体系或 Agent Tracing（LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse）的实战经验。

加分项

  • 有 MCTS、A\*、强化学习（RL） 与 LLM 结合的规划/推理研究或工程经验，熟悉 SFT / RLHF 训练流程。
  • 在 金融、Web3、合规 或其他高复杂度垂直领域有 Agent 系统落地经验，理解领域知识对 Agent 设计的特殊约束。
  • 有开源贡献或在 NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR 等顶会发表过 Agent / RAG / LLM 相关论文。
  • 具备 多模态（Multimodal） Agent 开发经验，包括图文理解、文档解析（PDF / 财报 / 研报）等非结构化数据处理能力。
  • 熟悉 MCP（Model Context Protocol） 或参与过 Agent 标准协议的设计与实现。

About the Role

We're at an inflection point where AI is fundamentally reshaping financial infrastructure. As an AI Agent Architect, you will be a core builder of AI's intelligent ecosystem — not just writing code, but defining how next-generation financial-grade Agents perceive market signals, plan execution paths, retain business context, and orchestrate across systems. You will lead the construction of Agent capabilities purpose-built for real financial scenarios: trading intelligence, risk assessment, compliance monitoring, and smart user services — engineered to operate autonomously in crypto finance's high-velocity, high-stakes, and high-compliance environment.This is a role with genuine technical ownership. You'll make architectural decisions that directly shape the experience of hundreds of millions of users, alongside an elite engineering team with exceptional depth in LLM and Agent technology.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Agent Architecture Design: Lead the architectural design of AI's intelligent Agent layer — defining agent execution models, lifecycle management, and resource isolation strategies on the Openclaw platform. Build the foundational Agent capabilities powering core financial scenarios including trading intelligence, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring, engineered for high-concurrency, low-latency, and regulatory-grade reliability.
  2. Financial Scenario Agent Engineering: Translate complex financial use cases — trading signal analysis, risk identification, regulatory compliance, and intelligent customer service — into production-ready Agent workflows. Design task planning chains (ReAct / Plan-and-Execute), fallback and error recovery mechanisms, and result validation frameworks that accelerate the path from PoC to production.
  3. Openclaw Platform Development & Evolution: Contribute deeply to the architectural evolution and performance optimization of the Openclaw Agent Runtime. Design the plugin ecosystem, capability registry, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms to reduce onboarding friction for product teams and improve platform extensibility and reusability.
  4. Tool Ecosystem & Internal System Integration: Build a standardized tool-calling framework connecting Bybit's internal trading engine, risk systems, data platforms, and external APIs. Design tool permission controls, call-chain tracing, and error recovery; integrate standards such as MCP to unify a financial-grade heterogeneous tool ecosystem.
  5. Production Quality & Observability: Lead the observability stack for Agent systems, including trace monitoring, evaluation pipelines, cost tracking, and latency governance. Establish quality baselines and regression testing frameworks for financial Agent scenarios, continuously improving system stability and interpretability.
  6. Technical Vision & Team Enablement: Track and internalize cutting-edge Agent research, translating advances into AI engineering practice. Define team-wide Agent development standards and best practices; drive AI-native engineering capability uplift through code reviews, technical sharing, and architectural reviews.

Requirements

  1. Proven LLM / Agent Engineering Experience: 3+ years of AI systems development experience, including 1+ year of production experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, or Agent frameworks; hands-on development and optimization experience with Openclaw, including familiarity with its Agent Runtime architecture, plugin ecosystem, and multi-agent orchestration mechanisms.
  2. Systems Architecture Proficiency: Strong distributed systems design skills including microservices architecture, message queues (Kafka / RabbitMQ), and async task scheduling; capable of independently driving the full decision chain from requirements analysis through architecture design to technology selection.
  3. Programming Expertise: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Golang / Java / Node.js); solid REST API design and containerized deployment skills (Docker / Kubernetes).
  4. Deep LLM Technical Understanding: Strong grasp of Transformer architecture, Attention mechanisms, and advanced Prompt Engineering (CoT, Few-shot, Structured Output); experience with major model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) and local deployment solutions (Ollama, vLLM).
  5. Engineering Quality Standards: Strong software design fundamentals (design patterns, unit testing, CI/CD); hands-on experience building LLM evaluation frameworks or Agent tracing pipelines (LangSmith / Phoenix / Langfuse).

Nice to Have

  • Experience combining MCTS, A\*, or Reinforcement Learning (RL) with LLMs for planning and reasoning; familiarity with SFT / RLHF training pipelines.
  • Proven Agent system deployments in high-complexity vertical domains such as Finance, Web3, or Compliance, with an understanding of domain-specific constraints on Agent design.
  • Open-source contributions or publications in NeurIPS / ICML / ACL / ICLR on Agent, RAG, or LLM-related topics.
  • Experience with multimodal Agent development, including vision-language understanding and unstructured document parsing (PDFs, financial reports, research papers).
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or prior involvement in designing and implementing Agent communication standards.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Senior Compliance Officer to build and run our global derivatives trade and transaction reporting function. The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation.
 
Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely.
 
This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. You will work with Trading, Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, local Compliance teams and reporting providers, and you will lead regulatory change in this space. Responsibilities for source data, systems, submissions and remediation will be agreed across those teams; you will lead the compliance framework and stay close enough to the process to identify and proactively resolve problems. You will report to the Head of Markets and Product Compliance and support a central function that owns reporting interpretation, scoping, oversight, and remediation for every entity in scope.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interpret and apply derivatives and transaction reporting rules across global regimes, including CFTC Part 45, MiFIR Article 26, EMIR Article 9, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and the ASIC Derivative Transaction Rules (Reporting) 2024, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and outside counsel.
  • Own and maintain entity, product, and transaction-level reporting scoping and eligibility: which entity reports, which products and lifecycle events are in scope, which counterparty role triggers the obligation, and which repository or authority receives the report.
  • Oversee, support, and help maintain the daily reporting process. Monitor submissions against deadlines, including T+1 for MiFIR transaction reports, investigate rejections and breaks, and track each one to resolution.
  • Reconcile reported activity to trading records and repository data, and coordinate corrections and back-reporting with the teams that own the relevant systems and data.
  • Define and maintain the reporting data specification with Engineering and Data, including field-level mapping, reference data such as LEIs, UTIs, UPIs, and ISINs, and the validation rules applied before submission.
  • Build and run the control framework: completeness, accuracy, and timeliness checks, exception management, management information, and records that hold up to regulator and audit review.
  • Drive reporting readiness and remediation. Assess new derivatives products, new entities, and regulatory changes, identify control gaps, agree on owners and deadlines across Compliance, Operations, Product, and Engineering, and track delivery.
  • Escalate material issues. Assess the impact of reporting errors, escalate to senior management, and support notifications to regulators where required.
  • Manage relationships with swap data repositories, trade repositories, approved reporting mechanisms, and reporting vendors, including onboarding, testing, and service issues.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small team, and coordinate with and train local compliance leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support regulator inquiries with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You 

  • A degree in finance, economics, law, data science, or computer science, or an equivalent professional qualification
  • 7+ years in trade reporting, transaction reporting, or regulatory reporting at an exchange, broker, bank, trading firm, fintech, or digital asset platform
  • Deep working knowledge of at least two of the following regimes: CFTC swap data reporting, MiFIR transaction reporting, EMIR, UK MiFIR, UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting. Hands-on experience with both a US and a European regime is strongly preferred.
  • A sound understanding of derivatives trade lifecycles and the data needed to report executions, changes, terminations and, where applicable, valuations and collateral.
  • The ability to interrogate large datasets, investigate reporting breaks and explain clear requirements to engineers and other business partners. SQL or comparable data analysis skills are highly desirable.
  • Experience building or improving a reporting framework, including procedures, reconciliations, exception management and evidence that can withstand regulatory or audit scrutiny; this may include remediating historical reporting errors, including back-reporting.
  • The judgment to make proportionate risk decisions, escalate material issues and lead delivery across teams without relying on a single team to own every part of the reporting process.
  • Experience with digital asset derivatives, such as perpetual futures and options, and how they map to reporting product classifications

Nice to Haves

  • Experience leading a regulatory reporting change program, such as EMIR Refit, UK EMIR Refit, the CFTC reporting rewrite, or the ASIC 2024 rules.
  • Familiarity with ISO 20022 XML reporting formats.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the role

Rain is building payments and stablecoin infrastructure, and our data platform holds some of the most sensitive data a company can have: cardholder, ledger, and partner data across many countries.

We’re looking for a Data Platform Engineer who has built and run data platforms for both batch and streaming to own the platform our data team and engineering pods depend on: the warehouse, streaming infrastructure, orchestration, BI, ML platform, access controls, and the tooling that makes all of it safe, reliable, and cost-efficient. Your product is the platform, and your customers are the engineers, analysts, and scientists who build on it.

You’ll own the platform layer: the data and ML platform, the infrastructure for ingestion and processing in batch and streaming, data governance and security compliance, the warehouse, and the analytics and BI tooling. Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and engineering pods build on it to run experiments, operate reliably, and turn data into decisions.

At Rain, we’re builders who use AI to automate repetitive work. That changes what data roles look like: where a data scientist used to only analyze and an analyst used to only build dashboards, here everyone models data, writes production-quality code, and automates their own workflows. You own the result, including checking what the AI produces. For this role, that means automating access, deploys, and governance so the platform runs itself and stays compliant.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build data platforms at scale for both batch and streaming, choosing storage, compute, and processing based on latency, cost, and reliability needs.

  • Own the infrastructure for BigQuery, streaming (such as Pub/Sub or Kafka, and Dataflow or Flink), Dagster+, and Lightdash as code, including environments, CI/CD, and deploys.

  • Own access and governance: IAM, policy tags, PII contracts, masked and no-PII access paths, and audit logs, across tables and streams.

  • Provide ML platform capabilities: feature pipelines, training data, and serving real-time features to fraud and risk models.

  • Build platform tooling: templates, CI checks, schema registry and data contracts, catalog, and lineage.

  • Monitor platform reliability, latency, and cost, and fix what is slow or expensive.

  • Design how backend events and CDC land in the warehouse, and advise backend pods on event design.

  • Respond to platform incidents and access requests, and automate the repetitive ones away.

What you’ll need

  • At least 4 years building and running data platforms in production on a cloud provider such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, in both batch and streaming: you have operated infrastructure for each, not only one.

  • Experience designing data platforms at scale: storage and compute choices, multi-team access, reliability, and cost.

  • Experience operating cloud data warehouses and real-time stores such as BigQuery and ClickHouse.

  • Experience operating streaming infrastructure such as Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow, or Flink, including retention, schema evolution, replay, and lag monitoring.

  • Experience operating batch infrastructure: orchestration (Dagster or Airflow), CI/CD, and environments.

  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform.

  • Experience with access control and data governance, such as IAM, column- or row-level security, and PII handling.

  • Strong Python and SQL.

  • Proficiency using AI tools to learn new skills and accelerate your work, while taking responsibility for checking the output.

Nice to have

  • ML infrastructure experience, such as feature stores, Vertex AI, or model serving.

  • Experience in regulated environments such as payments, banking, PCI, or SOC 2.

  • Experience with data catalogs and lineage tools.

  • Experience with cost optimization in BigQuery, ClickHouse, or Snowflake.

  • Experience with CDC tools such as Datastream or Debezium.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

About the job

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance


At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

We are seeking a highly driven Expansion Manager to expand Tether’s growth and presence in South Asia through adoption of its solutions, products and services. The Expansion Manager will play a pivotal role in identifying and executing new business opportunities, establishing strategic partnerships, and navigating regulatory landscapes. This role requires close collaboration with internal teams to develop and implement go-to-market strategies in South Asia and across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate professional who believes in financial inclusion, digital currencies, and driving innovation in APAC’s financial ecosystem. Frequent local and international travel is required.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with a proven track record in business development, market expansion, and partnership management. You have:

  • A degree in Business, Management, or Finance (MBA preferred).

  • Strong analytical skills and experience in setting/monitoring KPIs.

  • A proactive, independent, and well-organized approach to work.

  • The ability to thrive autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • A history of successfully building and managing strategic partnerships.

Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, engage, and secure new business opportunities in South Asia and in the Francophone region.

  • Build strong relationships with partners, customers, and stakeholders.

  • Build and manage commercial and strategic partnerships with Ivorian banks, fintechs and large corporates

  • Develop pipeline of USDt integration opportunities across the Francophone countries payment ecosystem

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Design and implement go-to-market strategies to expand Tether’s products and services.

  • Track and analyze KPIs to assess and optimize market strategies.

Market Research & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify trends, threats, and growth opportunities.

  • Analyze USDt and fiat flows for data-driven decision-making.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess their business impact.

Stakeholder & Government Engagement

  • Manage relationships with regulators, government agencies, and industry bodies.

  • Represent the company at key meetings and industry events.

Marketing & Community Engagement

  • Support and participate in fintech events, conferences, and meetups to enhance brand visibility.

Requirements:

  • Deep knowledge of the South Asia market, culture, and regulations in blockchain, fintech, finance, remittances, and payments.

  • Existing relationships at relevant regulators in South Asia

  • 7-10 years work experience in cross-border settlements, mobile money, and/or payment infrastructures; telecom or banking experience is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, with a Business, Management, or Finance degree (MBA preferred).

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with partners, regulators, and stakeholders.

  • Proven experience in partnerships, KPI monitoring, and business growth.

  • Analytical, strategic, and results-driven with problem-solving skills.

  • Entrepreneurial background and project management expertise.

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, evolving environments with international travel readiness.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Who We Are:

About DFNS

Finance is moving onchain. Stablecoins, tokenized deposits, securities and funds are changing how money and assets are issued, held and transferred. The destination is a financial system where any asset can be issued, moved and governed onchain with the controls regulated institutions require. That shift needs a new foundation. Just as core banking systems manage accounts and ledgers today, financial institutions need a platform to manage digital assets. DFNS is that platform. Today, we secure hundreds of billions of dollars in assets every month for more than 500 clients worldwide.

Why this role

Our platform processes transactions for banks and fintechs around the clock and it has run at 99.997% uptime since 2022 with zero breaches. That record is the product. You will own the infrastructure beneath it, from the Kubernetes clusters and pipelines that ship it to the AWS Nitro Enclaves that protect the signing path, across SaaS, hybrid and on-premise deployments at clients who run their own audits. In year one you will make every environment reproducible from code, turn observability into alerts that catch problems before clients do and carry the infrastructure controls through our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build and run the cloud infrastructure behind the platform on AWS, with security and scale as first principles.

  • Own the containerized platform (Docker, Kubernetes) and the way services are deployed, scaled and rolled back.

  • Make every environment reproducible from code with Terraform and CI/CD, so a new region, a client environment or a recovery is a pipeline run rather than a project.

  • Run observability end to end in Datadog (logs, metrics, traces) and turn it into alerting and on-call practice that catches problems before clients do.

  • Configure and operate the AWS Nitro Enclaves and secure workloads that protect key material and signing.

  • Keep Node.js services and the databases behind them fast and reliable under real financial workloads.

  • Support client deployments and due diligence, including hybrid and on-premise models and the questions a bank’s infrastructure team will ask.

  • Document what you build and carry the infrastructure controls through SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A record of designing and operating production infrastructure on AWS for systems where downtime or a breach has real consequences.

  • Deep, hands-on Kubernetes and container experience, from cluster operations to workload hardening.

  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD pipelines as the way you already work.

  • Observability in practice (Datadog or equivalent) and experience running on-call and incident response.

  • Working knowledge of infrastructure security and PKI fundamentals, including secrets, certificates and network segmentation.

  • Scripting and systems programming (Python, Rust or TypeScript) to automate what you own.

  • Experience administering and tuning SQL and NoSQL databases.

Nice-to-haves

  • Secure enclaves (AWS Nitro) or confidential computing.

  • HSMs and on-premise or hybrid deployments in regulated environments.

  • Blockchain nodes and networks in production.

  • Working knowledge of OpenShift, ECS, etc.

  • Working knowledge of GCP.

How we work

We are a distributed company headquartered in Paris. Our teams work from Europe, the US and Asia, with offices in New York, Geneva, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong and São Paulo. We write decisions down so they survive time zones. We hold our own work to the standards our clients are held to. We hire people who can own an outcome end to end and we give them the room to do it.

What we offer

A competitive base salary set by role and location, a bonus or variable plan where the role carries one and stock options vesting over four years. Healthcare, flexible vacation, parental leave and a once-a-year home technology allowance, with travel expenses covered. A MacBook and the equipment you need to do your best work. Remote first, with an office if you want one.

Base salary range: $250,000-350,000

Hiring process

We aim to complete the process in 2 weeks and we tell you where you stand after every step.

  • Intro call with Co-CEO (30 minutes).

  • Personality and cognitive assessments, completed on your own time (45 minutes).

  • A technical take-home exercise

  • Focus Interviews (about 2.5 hours): code review (45 minutes), architecture review (45 minutes), cross function (30 minutes) and security best practices (30 minutes).

  • Reference calls and background checks.

Equal opportunity

DFNS is an equal opportunity employer and considers every applicant based on ability and potential, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will arrange it.

About the position

We're opening our first internships in the Formal Methods group of our OCaml Language team, which develops language features and tooling for correctness reasoning and bug finding in OCaml programs. With the emergence of agentic programming, we think formal methods will play a major role in helping validate agent-generated code and providing feedback for agents. Our vision is to make formal methods as useful a tool for building software as type systems are for us today, both by leveraging existing tools and technology, and pursuing novel approaches. 

During the internship, we want to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll be paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on a real-world project that combines your research background with one of our active projects, such as adding support for property-based testing of formal specifications or developing a refinement type system for functional correctness verification. You’ll have the opportunity to evaluate the tools you develop on a large, actively developed production codebase. You'll also be able to attend guest speakers and social events, and hopefully get a real sense of what it would be like to work here full-time.

There is plenty of work on combining agents and formal methods. What’s different at Jane Street is that we aren't stuck designing verification tools for legacy languages: we can modify and improve OxCaml, our branch of OCaml, and its development environment to make them well-suited for proof-driven software development. Moreover, we have a community of excellent programmers who are eager to adopt these tools and apply them to real software.

Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

We're looking for PhD students, postdocs, and masters students with outstanding research experience in program verification, programming language semantics, property-based testing, static analysis, model checking, and related areas. You should be

  • A strong programmer who enjoys collaborating in small teams
  • Excited to turn research ideas into practical tools
  • Intellectually curious, humble and unafraid to ask questions 
  • Fluent in English

About the role:

AI is only as useful as the data it can safely reach. As Director, Data Architecture, you will own how our organization’s information, from databases to data warehouses to email, documents, Notion, Confluence, and Slack, becomes discoverable, trustworthy, and securely available to AI assistants, agents, and search tools.

This is a senior technical leadership role with enterprise-wide architectural accountability.  You will own the direction, make the platform and standards decisions, and partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, product, engineering, and business leaders to ensure AI retrieves the right information for the right people and processes. This role focuses on data enablement and does not involve model training or development. You will initially be a team of one, hands-on while setting the foundation, and will build and lead a team of data architects and engineers as the company scales.

Responsibilities:

Set the architecture and strategy

  • Own the enterprise target-state data architecture for AI enablement, spanning our data stores, integration layers, and a unified access layer across structured and unstructured content
  • Set reference architectures for retrieval-based AI: ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, and retrieval APIs
  • Establish company-wide standards for connectors, data contracts, APIs, and MCP-style integrations that expose enterprise data to AI tools
  • Own a 12-month delivery roadmap and a multi-year data and AI-readiness strategy aligned to business priorities and budget, and secure executive sponsorship for both

Connect structured and unstructured data

  • Set the ingestion approach for structured sources (ERP, CRM, finance, HR, operational systems) using batch, change detection, and streaming patterns
  • Set the ingestion approach for unstructured and semi-structured sources, including email, documents (PDF, documentation, spreadsheet, slides), wikis and knowledge bases (Notion, Confluence), collaboration tools (Slack, Google Drive), and ticketing systems (JIRA, Github)
  • Define  how content is parsed, cleaned, deduplicated, enriched with metadata, and kept fresh through incremental sync, change detection, and deletion handling
  • Create and oversee a semantic and metadata layer (taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs where useful) so content from different systems can be connected and searched coherently

Protect what matters

  • Be accountable for permission-aware AI retrieval that respects source-system access controls and user entitlements
  • Lead data governance in partnership with Security, Privacy and Legal , including cataloging, lineage, metadata, ownership, retention, and quality standards
  • Define enterprise policies for sensitive content in AI contexts, such as PII, confidential material, redaction, consent, and legal hold
  • Shape the organization’s AI data-risk posture and partner with Security, Privacy, and Legal to meet regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, SOX, EU AI Act as applicable)

Raise data readiness and quality

  • Define readiness criteria covering completeness, freshness, duplication, ownership, access rights, and content quality
  • Establish how retrieval quality, coverage, and stale content are measured, and ensure evaluation sets are maintained
  • Prioritize cleanup of high-value, high-risk sources such as outdated wikis, conflicting policy documents, and orphaned files
  • Act as the final check on delivery quality, ensuring the team’s output meets the standards of a scaling, high-growth environment

Lead the team and the conversation

  • Build the team over time, hiring and developing data architects and engineers, and set the operating model for data practices across the organization.
  • Translate AI use cases from application and business teams into enterprise clear data requirements and investment priorities
  • Own vendor strategy,  build-versus-buy analyses, and the related budget
  • Report progress, trade-offs, and risks to senior and executive stakeholders, escalating early with proposed mitigations

What We're Looking For:

Experience

  • 10+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or information management
  • 5+ years leading architecture functions or teams, with a track record of hiring, mentoring, and influencing across organizations.
  • A track record of delivering enterprise-scale cloud data platforms that integrate many source systems
  • Experience leading enterprise programs that integrate unstructured content (documents, email, wikis, collaboration tools) with structured data and search or retrieval architectures
  • Experience designing or governing access control and entitlement models for enterprise data
  • Proven delivery of data governance, cataloging, and data quality programs
  • Experience managing budgets and vendor relationships
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field (master's a plus)

Technical expertise

  • Cloud and data platforms: GCP; Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift; lakehouse formats such as Delta or Iceberg
  • Integration: CDC tools, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth
  • Source systems: Google Workspace, Notion, Confluence, Jira, Slack, Salesforce, Netsuite
  • Unstructured data: document parsing and OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, entity recognition, deduplication
  • Search and retrieval: Vector databases, hybrid keyword and semantic search, reranking, embedding pipelines
  • Security: IAM, ACL propagation, encryption, masking, tokenization, DLP, row and column-level security
  • Engineering: SQL and Python; CI/CD; Pulumi (sufficient depth to guide and review team design decisions)

Leadership qualities

  • Clear, executive-level communication and strong stakeholder management
  • The ability to build consensus across IT, security, legal, and business teams

Nice to Have

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Reduced the time to onboard a new data source for AI use

Great stories start with extraordinary people.

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

Story inspires science. Science makes story real.

Your Story

We're looking for a Creative Associate who can turn ideas into reality, fast. You'll work directly with Jason Carman, our founder, across both his companies Story and Wizard. Jason has more ideas than hands. Your job is to get those ideas out of his head and into the world: a deck by the end of the day, a video brief for the team, a social media campaign or post set up and then launched.

  • Make the decks. Turn rough thinking into sharp, beautiful decks, fast, using AI-assisted design tools like Claude Design and Figma.

  • Pull ideas out of Jason's head. Probe with questions and ideas until the thinking is clear, then capture it in a deck, a brief, or a plan.

  • Track every creative deliverable. Keep a clear view of what's in flight across Story and Wizard, who owns it, and what's next.

You're the Right Person If

  • You work extremely hard and learn incredibly fast.

  • You genuinely believe in what Story and Wizard are building. This will be your life's work while you're here.
